reviews.text: If your looking for a game to pass by some time and enjoy the aspect of grind and time played = progression and gear upgrades you will love this. The rewards feel tuned and enjoyable with my short time spent on this so far! Combat has skill to it and not just a left click buttons smasher with Q+E ability spam.

If you’re truly a fan of roguelike games, I highly recommend giving this one a try. Even though it’s still in Early Access, I barely ran into any major bugs. The combat is incredibly varied, the bosses are fun and challenging, and the enemy AI actually feels smart. Overall, the game already feels like a masterpiece. I played for 3 hours straight the moment it launched and absolutely loved it. WARNING: If you have a girlfriend, boyfriend, or spouse, be careful — this game will make you forget about them completely. Don’t end up getting complained at by your partner like I did.

Combat thus far consists of spamming your attack, at least the early enemy's that you run into don't have super armor so they just get stun locked then die. AI seems pretty poor, they instead throw lots of numbers at you hoping you're unable to withstand this & lose your run. Upgrades seem pretty boring & basic hey here is 20+ health +20 health +20 health hey you guessed it? 20+ health oh wait at the end something changes well I guess that's good. Repeats for damage +15 damage +15 damage +15 damage ect. If combat was more fluid/challenging & they didn't toss just sheer numbers at you instead actually had challenging fights I would have absolutely recommended this game but as it stands the AI is very poor, predictable & only sheer numbers will defeat you. No stamina system so you can freely spam attacks/dodge ect. I do think the game is correctly priced given how little depth this game provides. Upgrades when you level up are mostly boring/uninspired small stat increases but at this point if you've seen the other parts of this game you shouldn't be surprised at all. I do think this game has potential but needs a lot more time in the oven. I don't think the recipe will be altered enough to ever make this one worthwhile but I'd love to be wrong.

As someone who's been looking for a new rouglite/hack n slash to play this definitely checked my boxes, especially as I'm a fan of gladiators and roman mythology. For the game being released for 2 days (at the time of this review) I'm surprised at how much content there is and how fleshed out it felt. Its pretty nuanced and is at a great start. I've ran into no bugs (so far) and couldn't put it down. Fairly typical hack n slash rogue lite with the main controls being block, dodge, attack and 2 skills. Every day that you survive you upgrade your current equipment and unlock bonuses. Everytime you die you're sent to the death realm where you can unlock new skills and upgrade various attributes. It differentiates from button-mashing hack n slashes as timing is involved with blocking/dodging to survive longer (not to the extent of kingdom come deliverance or chivalry). You can die REALLY FAST. Pros: - Fights are challenging as the AI doesn't just throw itself at you - No bugs (that i've ran into) - high replayability as each run feels unique - Great variety from blacksmith with different item sets Cons: - Lacking from audio standpoint as there's no dialogue and its mostly sound effects - Does take time to make meaningful progress - Animations does feel a little janky and take time getting used to Feedback would be - Seeing inventory in blacksmith so you can see what items/sets you have equipped - Potentially adding dialogue to tie in the storyline a little better as the audio is a little lacking at this moment - Access to tutorial or a guide. Overall, if you're a fan of action rouglite/hack n slash then this is definitely a game worth trying, especially if you're a fan of Roman mythology and gladiators. Can't wait to see where this game goes!

Pretty fun so far! You can make some seriously broken builds, but its pretty random what upgrades you get after the fights. The combat can be a little janky at times, say, when you dodge an unblockable blow right into a dude swinging at you. Probably just a skill issue. Give me flails and dismemberment and I'll give it a 10/10. Otherwise its a 9.7 for me. Great game. Great, long progression. Easily worth the paltry price. ♥♥♥♥ Septimus. Cant exit to main menu in dead land. This game is fun, has a lot of potential, but needs work. Will update when that work is done.

Suprising work from Turkish publishers, excellent game if you enjoy the gladiator concept. It’s a roguelike, so if you die on day 30, you start over from day 1 and face the same bosses and enemies again. Despite its grindy nature, you should be able to finish the game in <15 hours with everything unlocked. Hope you enjoy it as much as I did! Also, don’t say I didn’t warn you: [spoiler]Break the Loop![/spoiler]

568 Despite being a roguelike, you don't really get a strong sense of progression. Although there are plenty of build options available, the randomness of the card draws shatters the illusion of build-crafting; you never feel like you have sufficient control, which often forces you to play with choices that are almost entirely random—and that you have no desire to use. Furthermore, the in-game animations feel quite sluggish. Overall, for a $10 title, it offers a solid experience in terms of the amount of playtime it provides. Pros: Fun Well-balanced difficulty level Cons: Lack of control over build-crafting variety

This is a fun and challenging roguelike game. There are still some bugs, and I wish there were more end of match choices with greater variety and randomization. However, even in its current state, the game is highly replayable and enjoyable. I'm looking forward to seeing how it develops over time and hope the developers continue to expand and improve it.

★★★★★ I love roguelike games, and this one definitely grew on me. At first, it took quite a while to understand all the mechanics (around 10 hours, haha). But after beating the first boss and getting comfortable with the gameplay, the game became incredibly fun. It's highly addictive, rewarding, and keeps pulling me back for "just one more run." My suggestions: - Increase item variety. Every weapon/type should have its own legendary-tier items to encourage different builds and playstyles. - I rarely felt the need to use my ultimate ability because the energy required to charge it takes too long to accumulate. Most of the time, the basic skill is enough. It would be more engaging if both basic skills and ultimates dealt less damage but could be used more frequently. - It would be great to have access to multiple basic skills and multiple ultimates in a single run, allowing for more build diversity and experimentation. Overall, once the learning curve is behind you, the game becomes extremely enjoyable and hard to put down.

[h1]《Trakonius》简评[/h1] [h1]剧情设定[/h1] 古希腊城邦奴隶制的时代，主角身为某个城市的战士守卫，亲眼见证了城池被敌人攻破、居民被敌人杀戮的战争惨状，而自己也被敌人抓住成为奴隶，被安排在一个角斗场中，以角斗士的身份和一波又一波的其他角斗士战斗。不过，主角貌似受到了神明的青睐，每一次死亡并非生命的结束，而是一轮新的开始，其可以利用之前战斗的收益，强化自身，然后浴血重生再一次以角斗士的身份在角斗场中继续杀戮。 [h1]动作战斗[/h1] 俯视视角动作战斗游戏，主要角色操作包括移动、普攻、（完美）格挡、（完美）闪避以及（基础/终极）技能。特殊的机制则包括了完美格挡/闪避的盾/闪反机制、破盾机制等等。动作战斗体验很不错，角色动作设计很合理，动作衔接很流畅，操作手感很丝滑，打击反馈也很厉害，尤其是角色攻击敌人能够打断大部分的攻击行动，这一点非常喜欢。至于游戏的难度，普通战斗的小怪还行，无非就是靠数量，玩家经常游走就好了，Boss战斗就不是那么容易了，尤其是红色攻击想要无伤有点难度需要操作。 [h1]肉鸽玩法[/h1] 游戏的本质也算是肉鸽了，不过这个肉鸽主要在于角色养成的构筑体系。局内战斗，构筑体系包括角色升级的技能奖励，角色武器装备（武器商店购买），武器装备词条羁绊效果等，角色死亡后等级清零、装备遗失。局外成长，技能解锁，天赋解锁等内容，永久生效。其实，还有一项内容，局内战斗休息区域的建筑功能升级，它属于局内成长的一环，但是升级后又可以永久生效。 [h1]最后[/h1] 游戏体验还不错，就是目前没有中文，看着脑壳疼，I need Chinese。 [quote]关注鉴赏组：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45134494]浮生评测[/url] ←"浮生若梦，一鉴倾心，邀您共赏人间烟火" 加入Steam组：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LLFLLFF]浮生评测[/url]←“一起追寻'浮生若梦'般的游戏体验” 开始“浮生若梦”鉴赏组的奇幻之旅！[/quote]

[h1][b]杀出竞技场[/b][/h1] 《Trakonius》是一款动作肉鸽游戏，主角是名英勇的战士，但却因神秘原因被困竞技场，只能日复一日的参与无情厮杀，随着一步步推进，真相也将被揭开。 游戏的战斗场景是一个巨大的圆形竞技场，而玩家扮演的则是供人观赏的困兽。游戏以天为单位推进，每一天都会迎来数场战斗，敌人会分成多波进攻。 一开始的敌人都很简单，只需要连续压制便可以用伤害贯死。随着天数增加，难度也会越来越高，会逐渐出现持盾防御的敌人、主打远程骚扰的弓箭手、攻击范围较远的长枪手等。 此外，场地中也会开始出现机关，比如人力驱动的巨型尖刺木桩等，玩家需要在战斗的同时进行躲避，如果面对多个敌人的围攻很容易分神。 本作的构筑手段较多，首先可以从商人处购买各种装备用来提升基础属性。升级后还会迎来经典的三选一增强，内容诸如冲刺时获得护甲、攻击敌人时降低其移速等。 游戏还打造了一个技能树，可以习得各种技能，效果诸如回血、释放箭矢、跳跃砸击等，可适配各种战斗风格。技能又可分为常规技能和终极技能，二者各可以装备一个。 每次死亡后还可以用获得的灵魂进行局外提升，这部分内容也以基础属性为主，不过数值就给的较高了，能很明显的感觉到变化。 游戏的手感还行，不温不火，初期攻速和移速较慢，在上述构筑环节进行提升后能好一点，可以进行翻滚和弹反。 整体来说还算可以的一款小体量肉鸽，缺点是缺少中文，希望尽快加入。 [quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/laoshirenLSR]老实人评测[/url]：独立游戏爱好者聚集地，黄油绅士交流中心。 不错过游戏的亮点，不放过游戏的槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote]
